summary: Configured and verified `Authorized access only` before local and SSH logins on node1. The configuration persisted across the required reboot, and SSH recovered healthy.
actions_performed: Set `/etc/issue` and `/etc/issue.net` to the required banner.
Configured sshd to use `/etc/issue.net` as its pre-authentication banner.
Generated missing SSH host keys and restored the previously failed SSH service.
Functionally tested both local getty and live SSH banner display.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed from `24163185-f2ac-4d25-822d-ce9bfa7178bc` to `7b66215f-ecae-4c2f-ae30-a5908c7bd7f3`.
Confirmed banner persistence, SSH health, listeners, and both login-path tests after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Display `Authorized access only` before local logins
evidence.summary: Configured `/etc/issue`; agetty rendered the required text both before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Display `Authorized access only` before SSH logins
evidence.summary: Configured the sshd Banner directive, confirmed the service and port 22 listeners, and proved via live unauthenticated connections that the banner appears before authentication failure, including after reboot.
Shows the healthy baseline and old boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and complete post-restart service and banner recovery.
